evidence.quote: Resolved: Shareholders request that the Board commission a third-party assessment, at reasonable expense, of additional actions the company could take to mitigate the proliferation of false information on the platform and report to shareholders...

evidence.quote: Our Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST the shareholder proposal because: • Our existing multi-layered governance framework, grounded in our foundational AI Principles...
